units.source_text: 即使是浮士德博士都不会有这种梦想。

en.t: Even Doctor Faust would never dream of such a thing.

units.source_text: 像牛和印度牛、马和驴之类的动物，也有受孕的吧。

en.t: Animals such as cattle and Indian cattle, or horses and donkeys, can conceive too, I suppose.

units.source_text: 嗨，充其量不过是在海中区区的下等动物身上，试着做实验罢了。”

en.t: Well, at most it is only a matter of trying the experiment on some lowly creatures in the sea.”
